settings.description: Toyo's flagship all-terrain — 3PMSF rated, 100,000 km warranty. Quiet on Deerfoot highway and rugged on gravel east of Calgary.
Studless winter tire built for cold-Canadian packed snow. Hydrophilic compound stays grippy below -25°C without losing dry-pavement composure on warmer winter days.
3PMSF-rated all-weather. Meets Alberta winter law year-round — skip the seasonal swap. Toyo's answer to the CrossClimate2 at a friendlier price.
Rugged terrain — more aggressive tread than the A/T III for trucks and Jeeps that see real off-road. Still pavement-friendly enough for daily driving.

settings.subtitle: Toyo is the brand Calgary truck and SUV owners reach for when they want serious off-road capability — the Open Country A/T III is one of our most-installed all-terrains. We also stock the Observe GSi-6 (winter), Celsius II (all-weather), and Open Country R/T at 111 42 Ave SW.
settings.intro_heading: Why we recommend Toyo in Calgary
settings.intro_richtext:
Toyo has been engineering tires in Japan since 1945. They're best known in Calgary for the Open Country line — All-Terrain, Rugged Terrain, and Mud-Terrain — which dominates our truck and SUV install bays from spring through fall.

The Open Country A/T III is 3PMSF-rated and quiet enough for daily Deerfoot commuting, but built tough enough for gravel runs to Ghost Lake or back-roads east of Calgary toward Strathmore and Indus. The Open Country R/T takes it further with a more aggressive tread for serious off-road use.

For sedans and crossovers wanting one tire all year, the Celsius II is Toyo's all-weather (3PMSF) answer to the Michelin CrossClimate2 — same idea, friendlier price. For drivers who want a dedicated winter, the Observe GSi-6 is studless winter built for cold-Canadian-winter packed snow.

Every Toyo we install gets the same balance, calibrated torque, and TPMS reset — and we price-match local Calgary competitors. Book installation or call (403) 452-4283.
settings.cta_description: Most Open Country sizes in stock. Same-day install on confirmed bookings — price-matched against any local Calgary competitor.
settings.faq_1_q: Is the Toyo Open Country A/T III 3PMSF rated?
settings.faq_1_a: Yes. The Open Country A/T III carries the 3PMSF (three-peak mountain snowflake) symbol, which meets Alberta's winter-tire law and the BC Highway 93 / Trans-Canada Banff winter-tire mandate.
settings.faq_2_q: What's the best Toyo tire for Calgary winters?
settings.faq_2_a: For dedicated winter, the Observe GSi-6 (sedans/crossovers) or Observe GSi-6 LS (SUVs/trucks). For one-tire-year-round, the Celsius II — it's 3PMSF rated and meets Alberta winter law, so no swap needed.
settings.faq_3_q: How much do Toyo Open Country tires cost in Calgary?
settings.faq_3_a: Open Country A/T III ranges $280–$500 per tire depending on size. Smaller fitments (P265/70R17) start around $290; larger LT sizes (LT285/70R17) run $440–$500. The R/T runs $20–80 more per tire than the A/T III in matched sizes.
settings.faq_4_q: Open Country A/T III vs R/T — which one for daily Calgary driving?
settings.faq_4_a: A/T III if you're 80%+ on pavement (Deerfoot, Stoney Trail, Memorial). R/T if you spend significant time on gravel or off-road. Both are quieter than they look, but A/T III is noticeably quieter on highway.
settings.faq_5_q: Can I get same-day install on Toyo Open Country?
settings.faq_5_a: Yes for most stocked sizes if booked before midday. Bigger LT sizes need a 60-minute slot. We carry the most common A/T III sizes (LT265/70R17, LT275/65R18, 285/70R17, etc.). Call (403) 452-4283 to confirm.
settings.faq_6_a: Open Country A/T III carries a 65,000-mile (100,000 km) treadwear warranty. Celsius II carries a 60,000-mile warranty. Observe GSi-6 and R/T are non-warrantied per industry convention for dedicated winter and rugged terrain tires. All come with Toyo's manufacturer defect coverage.
settings.calgary_richtext: Toyo is a Calgary truck-and-SUV favourite. Open Country A/T III is what we install on F-150s and Tundras running Highway 22 and the oilfield. Celsius is the brand's 3PMSF all-weather pick — meets Alberta's winter-tire law and we install plenty of them on family SUVs. Proxes Sport handles the performance lane for tuned street cars in the spring and summer.
settings.awards_text: Open Country A/T III is one of the most-installed truck and SUV tires in Western Canada.
settings.testimonial_quote: Open Country A/T III on my Ram. Used them for two oilfield seasons, the tread is still there. These tires earn their keep.
